model_family: Conditional tens/units transition by prize position; previous lag 1/7; same/next position; direct/cross digits; 30/90 draw training windows; mix with hot30 unique/occ and hot90 occ
implementation: JavaScript evaluation isolated from production. For target i, conditional transitions estimated only from j<i and source j-lag. Conditional tens/units probabilities with Laplace alpha=2; score sum over 27 positions; normalize each channel by per-day cross-number standard deviation; select top3 numbers. Deterministic Halton q=1..576; reject repeated transition-channel triplets.
selection: Select by train400_hits, tie-break train400_nhay. Last100 is previously inspected retrospective data, NOT an independent holdout.
caveats: Last100 inspected in earlier model searches; no independent generalization claim.
Selection across many model families inflates retrospective best.
Baseline 283/500 from older KNN report still not reproduced.
CSV includes four-day gaps 2025-01-28..31 and 2026-02-16..19; lag is by observed draw index, not calendar day.
